entities.summary: Isabelle Djibgodi Améganvi Manavi born in Kpalimé, Togo, is a Togolese lawyer and politician. She was elected to Togo's parliament in 2007. She is well-known for orchestrating a sex strike in August 2012, protesting electoral reforms that favored the party in power. In 2013, she was elected to the National Assembly a second time.
